method: Direct Japanese authoring for both Chinese locales followed by complete own-source semantic self-review of every string. No external translation service, other-pair reading or cross-review.
coverage: Every title, complete explanatory/example paragraph, prompt, glossary term and illustration alt from collectTranslatableUnits.
semanticChecks: Refractory and insulation roles remain distinct; furnace name, weight and total quantity do not establish layer-specific material compatibility.
Refractory mortar is not interchangeable with construction mortar; heat-setting and air-setting conditions do not establish immediate readiness.
Wet/powder delivery forms retain product-specific preparation conditions; no mix ratio, cure time or heating condition invented.
Marking/datum identity, joint dimensions/materials, cut-piece suitability and measured horizontal/vertical directions are not inferred from photos.
Fire-pump infrequent use does not waive checks; water volume, suction paths and priming are separately confirmed.
Priming tank existence and water-level photos do not authorize operation; arrangements depend on pump system.
Closed-discharge operation is a condition name, not permission; relief-pipe existence does not establish heat-control function.
External relief piping and integral mechanisms remain distinct; temperature-control function does not permit dry running.
Motor rotation is distinct from rated pumping performance; flow units, head, pressure and current display identities retained.
Certified pump unit does not certify site pipework; lining color does not establish material or heat resistance.
Same diameter and prior adoption do not approve alternative firefighting pipe material.
